question: Is Lord-will the cause, sole descent-cause — and is japa action-power not karma?
premises: Lord-will is cause; and if descent-sole-causality
inference: Will-causes; japa is action-power, not karma-proper.
plain_english: Lord-will is cause; and if descent-sole-causality — japa-and-the-like is action-power indeed thus, but not karma, that.
